facts.fact: The national statistics strategy 2022-2026 states that statistical activity in Congo is governed by statistics law no. 36-2018 of 5 October 2018 on official statistics.
facts.system: Loi n° 36-2018 sur la statistique officielle (2018)

facts.fact: The Journal officiel no. 42 of 18 October 2018 carries the text of law no. 36-2018 on official statistics; the date given is the issue's publication date, as the passages show no promulgation date for this law.
facts.system: Loi n° 36-2018 sur la statistique officielle (2018)

note: SPI 5.1.1 legislation score names no law or year; no fact.

facts.fact: INS Congo's October 2026 release calendar states that loi n° 36-2018 sur la statistique officielle is the national legal framework on which the calendar rests.
facts.system: loi n° 36-2018 sur la statistique officielle

facts.fact: INS Congo issued its 2026 advance release calendar in October 2026, stating it answers the requirements of loi n° 36-2018.
